data.name: Advanced Assassin Path
data.description: When using the Assassin trance, you deal sneak attack as a rogue of half your psychic warrior level.  Your target must be eligible for sneak attack.  In addition, when using the Assassin maneuver, your opponent is staggered for %1 rounds (Fort DC %2 negates).|AdvancedAssassinPathDuration|AdvancedAssassinPathDC
prerequisites: PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Assassin's Path ~ First,Assassin's Path ~ Second
